# Cncf Oauth2 Proxy Reviewer

Review OAuth2 Proxy using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. A generic reverse proxy that provides authentication with Google, Azure, OpenID Connect and many more identity providers.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
